original_test_intent: Verify every in-scope physical USB port detects the approved test device in BIOS and the OS, with per-port identity and controller-path evidence.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Check all USB ports with a device; all USB ports can be detected in BIOS/OS.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Devices can be detected under OS.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; operator attaches device, agent runs lsusb; irrelevant ip-link output was included.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED because port/controller/device matrix and BIOS/OS acceptance were undefined.
historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION as a manual attachment/BIOS plus automated OS evidence workflow.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer moves the approved device through each mapped physical port and records BIOS detection; agent may collect OS enumeration/topology and kernel evidence after each placement.
required_user_inputs: Approved device identity, driver and power expectations
Per-port BIOS and OS detection criteria
Insertion order, safe removal and recovery plan

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: All USB ports in BIOS/OS; 20/20-minute planning values.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Define the platform's actual port matrix, device set, controller paths and meaning of detection/use.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Testing one port or one lsusb snapshot cannot satisfy the master all-port scope; N/A ports require an engineer-approved applicability record.

original_method: Manual USB placement and BIOS observation plus OS-side `lsusb`; preserve both interfaces. Remove `ip link` because it does not prove USB detection.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use `lsusb`, `lsusb -t`, stable VID:PID/serial identity and timestamped kernel USB enumeration after every approved placement, while retaining manual BIOS evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Linux project image with usbutils; BIOS steps remain platform-specific.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Project-qualified usbutils/kernel version must be recorded.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Linux USB userspace/kernel documentation or distro package manual for the installed version; project BIOS specification supplies port expectations.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Adds per-port topology and identity instead of a single device list.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not automate physical movement or BIOS observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Enumeration does not by itself prove device function; avoid bootable/sensitive media and unexpected automount.

safety_boundaries: Do not attach arbitrary bootable, storage, security or over-current devices.
Stop on unexpected mount, overcurrent, controller error or console/boot impact.
Preserve logs and restore the original peripheral state.
expected_evidence: Per-port physical identity and BIOS capture
Per-placement lsusb/topology/kernel evidence tied to device identity
Complete coverage matrix including N/A disposition
no_automatic_retry: A failed enumeration stays recorded. Moving the device again, changing driver/power policy or repeating a port requires the approved plan or new engineer direction.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent reports per-port facts and gaps; engineer determines detection PASS/FAIL/N/A/BLOCKED.
review_improvement: KEEP because V3 already restores the all-port hybrid scope and rejects single-snapshot false completion. V3.1 makes project-specific port applicability and coverage accounting explicit without weakening the physical or BIOS boundary.
